call_points.text: MINPRO JV with Khemka: ₹35 Cr initial investment over two years, production targeted for Q4FY27.
Quartzite mines Chiraipani and Bhikampali expected to open by end of this quarter, with cost benefits from next quarter.
No project orders in Q1; glass and silica projects expected in Q3 and Q4, coke oven project at final negotiation.
Steel sector capex estimated at not less than ₹50,000-60,000 Cr this financial year, supporting refractory demand.
Magnesite prices rose 6-8% in the last two months; management is working to absorb or pass on the increase.
Alumina prices stable over the last six months, with no significant movement.
Cash and cash equivalents of ₹452 Cr; balance sheet net cash positive.
Exports declined from last quarter to this quarter; management expects flow control exports to rise over the coming months.
Auditor resigned mid-year to align with the parent group's auditor change; same auditors to be adopted at the upcoming AGM.
Management guides for full year FY27 EBITDA margin at 13%.
FY27 capex is projected around ₹150 Cr covering Dalmia, Bhiwadi, and Jamshedpur plants.

timeline.summary: In May 2026, RHI Magnesita India issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for material related-party transactions with RHI Magnesita GmbH for FY27 to FY29.
In May 2026, RHI Magnesita India's subsidiary board approved the sale of industrial land and machinery at its closed Bhilai plant.
In May 2026, RHI Magnesita India announced the board approval for the merger of its wholly owned subsidiary Intermetal Engineers into Ashwath Technologies.
In May 2026, RHI Magnesita India adjourned its board meeting for Q4 and FY26 financial results to May 29, 2026, due to delayed subsidiary financial approvals.
In May 2026, RHI Magnesita India reported FY26 revenue of ₹4,020 Crore and operating cash flow of ₹409 Crore, alongside a goodwill impairment loss.
RHI MAGNESITA INDIA LTD shared the audio recording link of its 30 May 2026 conference call on its website.
In June 2026, RHI Magnesita India hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for a 13% EBITDA margin in FY27.

RHI Magnesita India reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹1,014 Cr (+6% YoY) and PAT of ₹65 Cr, and on its 12 August 2026 call held FY27 EBITDA margin guidance at 13% while trimming volume growth guidance to 7-8%.
